The '''Frostflower Path''' was a roadway that ran along the coastline in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], continuing from the [[Wooded Valley]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] to the west. The area was inhabited by creatures such as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cats]], [[bolraida]]s and [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|flutterplumes]]. A small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] medical post was located in the area during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]] troops loyal to [[House of Thul|House Thul]] patrolled parts of the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frostflower Path first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massivley multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
